overall_comment: Prediction is based only on structured conventional MRI metadata. Lack of DWI/ADC, perfusion, spectroscopy, SWI/GRE, and histopathology limits certainty, especially for molecular subtype. The large, markedly enhancing, necrotic, ependymal-invasive lesion in an elderly patient is most compatible with IDH-wildtype glioblastoma.
